collection.title: Ford Transit Custom 2012 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Transit Custom 2012 - 2022 requires a 30" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 28" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Tourneo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
